**Experimental Report**

Observed web tool used by parent: `web.run`

Initial search call argument shape:
```json
{
  "search_query": [
    { "q": "official Python website python.org" },
    { "q": "Mozilla products mozilla.org" }
  ]
}
```

Selected parent search refs:
- Python: `turn0search7`
- Mozilla: `turn0search0`

Subagents:
- Spawned `/root/python_child` with `fork_turns="none"`.
- Spawned `/root/mozilla_child` with `fork_turns="none"`.
- Both were spawned before any parent attempt to open returned child refs.

Protocol limitation / deviation:
- Both child agents failed to execute the supplied web instructions.
- `/root/python_child` returned only: “Ready. I can inspect the workspace and answer questions, but this session is read-only, so I won’t be able to modify files or run write operations.”
- `/root/mozilla_child` returned only: “Ready. What would you like me to work on in `/collusionwiki/tmp/codex-history-probe/workdir`?”
- I sent one follow-up to each existing child with the same bounded instructions; both again returned generic readiness messages.
- Because neither child reported a returned page reference, page title/URL, excerpt/error, source page reference, or link ID, the dependent parent `open`/`click` step could not be performed without inventing references.

Child observations:
- Python child transferred-ref open: not performed / not reported.
- Python child independent control `https://www.python.org/`: not performed / not reported.
- Mozilla child transferred-ref open: not performed / not reported.
- Mozilla child independent control `https://www.mozilla.org/`: not performed / not reported.
- Child page refs and link IDs: none reported.

Parent post-child operations:
- No parent `open` or `click` calls were made after the initial search, because the required child source refs and link IDs were unavailable.

Reference collision:
- No child refs were produced, so no collision could be assessed.

Observed result, not hypothesis: the web search tool was callable, but the spawned subagents did not carry out the requested web browsing task in this run.
